newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to acquire another car group.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to acquire another car group.

text.p: Florida billionaire H. Wayne Huizenga's Republic Industries Inc. said Monday it has agreed to acquire the Dobbs Automotive Group of Memphis, Tenn., for $200 million in common stock.
Dobbs is the nation's seventh-largest auto dealer group, with outlets in Tennessee, Alabama, North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida and Arizona, Republic said.
The acquisition will include all related real estate.
Republic, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., is already the nation's largest auto dealer group through just seven months of aggressive acquisitions.
Republic said it has long-term employment agreements to allow Dobbs CEO John Shanks and Frank Grese, the company's chief operating officer, to continue managing the dealerships.
Republic said it expects to enter similar employment agreements with the rest of Dobbs' senior management team and other employees.
Republic also has subsidiaries in the automotive retailing, automotive rental, automotive financial services, solid waste services and electronic security services industries.
Republic's stock fell 37.5 cents to $23.06 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
